heading: DailyObjects in talks to raise ₹350 crore led by Xponentia and Anicut Capital as demand for lifestyle tech grows
author: LiveMint Editorial
paragraphs: DailyObjects is finalising a  ₹350 crore funding round led by Xponentia Capital and Anicut Capital at a valuation of about  ₹1,000 crore, with funds going towards products and distribution.
